brief:
Israeli former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett has proposed a significant shift in strategy involving military strikes against Iran in response to actions by Hezbollah, the Ma'an news agency reported. The proposal marks a hardline position on Israeli regional security doctrine and the scope of diplomatic involvement in the Palestinian territories.

Bennett's remarks also include a call to exclude Qatar and Turkey from any future role in Gaza affairs, signaling a narrower approach to international mediation. The statement reflects ongoing divisions within Israeli political circles over how to address threats from multiple actors operating across the region's various conflict zones.
title: Bennett calls for Iran strikes, Qatar and Turkey removal from Gaza
